d:
A blast on a railway track in Rajasthan’s Sri Ganganagar on November 3 has exposed an alleged terror network linked to Pakistan. Police have arrested 21-year-old Mahakdeep Kaur and 23-year-old Devinder Singh from Punjab’s Gurdaspur. Investigators suspect links to Pakistan-based handlers and the ISI. According to police, the woman was allegedly lured into the network through a romantic relationship and financial incentives. How did the alleged honey trap work, and what was the plan behind the railway blast?
